anna_docs: Hey team — finalizing whats-new + changelog for the adaptive routing + batch cache features. Draft is in the doc: https://docs.internal/release/3728. Need: 1) confirm SDK snippets run 2) callout for streaming embeddings known issue 3) short known-issues blurb for changelog. Ping @miguel_eng and @sam_engineering for snippet check. :eyes:

miguel_eng: On it. I'll run through the Go + Python snippets in the PR branch. Any specific parts to sanity-check?

anna_docs: Mainly the streaming embed example and the snippet that shows function-calling fallback. See code block below for the problematic one.

anna_docs: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = c.chat.create(model="kestrel-1", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"summarize repo"}], stream=False)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

miguel_eng: Small note: we deprecated `chat.create` in favor of `responses.create` last week. Should update snippet to match SDK v0.9. Also streaming param is `stream=True/False` is fine. I'll push a tiny snippet PR.

sam_engineering: Also there's a bug logged — #4721 — where embeddings streaming can drop the first chunk for sequences > 2048 tokens. For changelog known issues, wording suggestion: "Embeddings streaming may omit initial vectors for very long inputs — workaround: use non-streaming embeddings or chunk inputs." Should we link the GH issue in the changelog?

jess_product: For whats-new headline: "Faster inference via adaptive routing and batch caching — up to 3x tail-latency improvement." Maybe tone down to "up to 3x" (as written). Add CTA: "See migration notes for SDK updates." Also add a sentence: "Dedicated customers: no behavior change expected."

ben_sre: FYI, we had a small rollback yesterday in eu-west due to autoscaler churn — please add a short ops caveat: "Temporary scaling rollback in EU region; no customer request loss; ongoing tuning." I'll attach the postmortem link in the doc.

deploy-bot: deployment notice: Code deployed to docs site at 2026-03-22T14:02:11Z (deploy/website v2.14.0) :rocket:

anna_docs: Thanks all. Miguel — when you push the snippet PR, can you add a short unit test? I will also include a "how to migrate" sub-bullet for CLI commands.

miguel_eng: Yep, created PR #7832 with updated snippets + tests. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7832

anna_docs: Great. For final changelog bullets I propose:
- Adaptive routing: routed requests now prefer low-latency pools; fallback to cost-tiered model variants when congested.
- Batch cache: automatic prefix/KV caching reduces per-token cost for repeated contexts.
- Known issue: embeddings streaming with >2048 tokens may lose first chunk. Workaround: non-streaming embeddings or chunked inputs.

sam_engineering: LGTM, maybe add one line about SDK rename `chat.create` -> `responses.create` in migration notes.

jess_product: Approved :thumbsup: I'll queue the whats-new banner.

ben_sre: Optional: add support contact link for any immediate regressions.

anna_docs: Will do. ETA to publish: today EOD if no other changes. Thanks :tada:
